Hi Aria / procurement team,

Thanks again for a productive call this morning — quick recap and a few asks so we can line up the right commercial path for NovaCorp.

Call highlights
- Primary use case: customer-facing search/chat across product docs & CRM data (low to medium PII).
- Expected 90-day trial tokens: ~15M tokens, ramping to ~120M /mo if pilots succeed.
- Key constraints: procurement prefers vendor PO, finance needs 30-day terms, legal wants SOC2 evidence, security is evaluating VPC/private options for regulated customers.

Open asks (so we can recommend Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private)
1) Procurement preference: PO vs card? ACH vs credit card?
2) Marketplace interest: would a marketplace purchase (AWS/GCP) simplify procurement for you?
3) Billing entity and invoicing cadence: legal entity to appear on PO; net terms desired.
4) Timeline: target procurement sign-off date for pilot and for full purchase.

What I attached
- pricing-summary.xlsx (high-level hosted / dedicated / private sketches + commit vs on-demand estimates)
- SOW-draft-v1.pdf (scope for pilot + acceptance criteria)

Recommended next steps
- If PO is preferred: schedule a short procurement sync to confirm PO fields and PO routing (30 min).
- If marketplace is desired: we can pull marketplace pricing and see if it meets your internal cost controls.

Proposed times for procurement + finance sync: Thu Mar 3 10:00-10:30 AM PT or Fri Mar 4 2:00-2:30 PM PT. Tell me what works and I’ll send a calendar invite.

Thanks — looping in Ben and Marcus to prepare the technical and commercial notes respectively.

Best,

- Procurement preference: PO (primary). We will not use a corporate card for a multi-month pilot at this stage.
- Payment method: ACH preferred; finance typically issues payment on Net 30 once PO is received.
- Marketplace: open to marketplace purchase but it must be cost-comparable and not delay timelines. Would need SKU mapping from you to assess.
- Legal / Security asks: please share SOC2 Type II report (we requested the link during the call), and a short data flow diagram for pilot hosting.
- Timeline: procurement can turn a PO in ~10 business days once fields are confirmed; legal review typically 7–10 business days for SOW-level agreements.

I attached our procurement checklist to show the PO fields that must be present.

Happy to take the 30 min sync on Thu Mar 3 10:00 AM PT — I’ll accept if you send the invite.

Subject: Re: Post-call: procurement & hosting pathway checklist (Redwood + NovaCorp)

Appreciate the quick turnaround, Aria. Answers inline and a short commercial note below so procurement has options to evaluate before the sync.

PO fields
- We can populate the typical PO fields (billing entity, remit-to, contact, SOW reference, payment terms). I’ll generate a PO template showing what we need.

Marketplace vs direct PO
- Marketplace: pro - consolidated billing and existing procurement flow; con - marketplace fees can raise unit price by ~5–12% depending on vendor. If NovaCorp values single-vendor invoices, marketplace may be attractive.

High-level pricing posture (see attached pricing-summary.xlsx for numbers)
- Hosted (Redwood managed, on-demand): fastest onboarding, no infra commit. Pilot pricing estimate: $0.0009 per prompt token equivalent (example). No minimum commit.
- Dedicated (reserved GPU pool): lower per-token costs at steady state — we recommend a 12-month commit for best economics (we can structure quarterly ramp).
- Private (VPC or on-prem): higher base setup and ops fee, recommended for regulated workloads; pricing typically quoted as a project + recurring infra uplift.

Suggested procurement routing for pilot
1) PO for pilot (hosted on-demand) to meet procurement needs quickly.
2) After pilot: evaluate Dedicated 12-mo commit if usage justifies — Marcus will prepare commit vs on-demand delta.
3) If legal/security insist on private hosting for pilot customers: we can scope a limited private pilot, but expect additional onboarding time.

Next steps for Thu Mar 3 10:00 AM PT
- I’ll send the invite and include: procurement, finance, legal (if possible), Ben for tech/Q&A, Marcus for commercial.
- Ben: can you prepare a 1-page tech note + data flow diagram for the pilot?
- Marcus: please prepare a short commit vs on-demand delta (12-month example) and a concise seller-side PO template we can send to procurement.

Thanks — attaching the pricing sheet again.

Cheers,
Lauren

Attachments: pricing-summary.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
